fusions.name: Heavy Hang
fusions.desc: Hauls the head across every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 8 damage, stripping 8% of their armour for 3 seconds and slowing them by 20%. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Eventual Verdict
fusions.desc: A slow, certain blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.
